correctness.rationale: The local mutation criterion was checked against the primary source and the arithmetic proof was independently reconstructed. With \(n=a+1\) and \(d=b\), every descending pair corresponds bijectively to \(m=n^2/d<d\le N\) with \(md\) a square; writing \(m=sv^2\), \(d=su^2\) with squarefree \(s\) gives the stated binomial summation. The error from replacing the floor-square term by \(N/s\) is \(O(N)\), and the standard squarefree harmonic sum gives the coefficient \(3/\pi^2\). Independent exact enumeration matched the formula at several \(N\), including 100 and 200.
